test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state government launched the "Panchamrut Yojana"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Uttar Pradesh government **announced that **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's 'Panchamrut Yojana'** will aid in doubling farmers' income through the implementation of cost-effective technical measures and the promotion of co-cropping.
 
• An official from the Sugarcane Development Department has announced that the government has already begun implementing the Panchamrut Yojana.
 
• The first phase of the plan will include 2028 farmers, selected to create model farms.
 
• The goal is to encourage other farmers to join in, seeing the benefits firsthand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A press release from the UP government explains the** Panchamrut scheme's goals.**
 
• It aims to cut down the cost of growing **sugarcane, boost the quantity produced, and make the soil healthier.**
 
• It does this by using five methods: a special way of planting sugarcane, managing old crop stalks, using crop waste as mulch, efficient watering, and growing different crops together.
 
• The plan hopes to cut costs by saving water and making the most of **crop leftovers, reducing the need for fertilizers and pesticides.**
 
• It promotes growing more than one type of crop to boost overall production.
 
• This scheme will also increase farmers' earnings and help control pollution by removing the need to burn leftover crop parts in the fields.
